notes: Both supplied units use the two-character string 趙倫 only as a historical exemplum of rebellion or usurpation, not as a biographical identification: 蕭勃干紀，非唯趙倫 and 為趙倫之事. Treating 趙倫 as a shared full personal name would equate a possible surname-plus-given reading in Chen Shu with the conventional fief-plus-given label for Lun, Prince of Zhao, without an attested alias chain in these units. A merge may not rest on that string, Romanization, or the untrusted AD 301 rebel hints.
